text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’ve built an inventory reconciliation automation workbook for Coastline Hardware using Excel, Power Query, and SQL. It matched warehouse counts to the ERP every week, flagged variances, found $86k of stock variance, and cut weekly reconciliation from 6 hours to 20 minutes.

For your business, I can help cross-check all sales and expenses against Receipt-Bank/DEXT and QuickBooks, clean up unreliable bookkeeping data, create a detailed business budget, build a family budget, and design an inventory sheet that tracks stock cost versus selling price for profit calculations. I can also help organize your documents into a clearer system.

Would you like me to start by mapping your current bank, card, and Receipt-Bank workflow into a reconciliation template?
